description:
A stunning detached residence in the heart of Blackrock situated in a quiet secure enclave behind electric gates, 16 Clonfadda Wood is a most impressive bright and spacious family home that has been exceptionally well-maintained and upgraded. Benefitting from well-proportioned living accommodation bathed in natural light as well as four generous bedrooms, this stylish property provides comfort and flow in a location of unparalleled convenience.

Approached by a neat cobble lock driveway with parking for three cars and a manicured lawn and beds, the front door opens into a warm and welcoming entrance hallway. To the right, a dual aspect living room runs from front to back and enjoys sunshine throughout the day. A door leads through to the dining room with picture window overlooking the rear garden and opens into the kitchen, with French doors to the rear garden and a sleek modern kitchen. A convenient utility is located off this with access to the side passageway. To the front left is a smart study/TV room with a guest w.c. and cloak cupboard completing the accommodation at ground level. Upstairs, four double bedrooms include a principal suite with newly-fitted en-suite shower room, a second en-suite and a family bathroom. The rear garden is a particular feature of the property, accessed from both the kitchen and living room and with large patio area enjoying sunshine throughout the day. The property has been extensively upgraded to include Carlson windows, insulation, integrated stove and modern finishes. 

The location is of unparalleled convenience being situated within walking distance of Blackrock Village with its wide array of restaurants, cafes, boutique style shops, two shopping centres and the vibrant amenities at the Blackrock Market.  The property is also situated within a pleasant stroll of Blackrock Park, Carysfort Park and many pleasant coastal walks.  Transport options are excellent being close to the Quality Bus Corridor (QBC) as well as the DART making access to the city centre very simple and the M50 is also close at hand opening up the national road networks. Further amenities are available at Stillorgan.  One is spoilt for choice in terms of excellent schools being  situated in the vicinity of some of South County Dublin’s most highly regarded schools including Blackrock College, Willow Park, St. Andrew’s, Booterstown National School, Our Lady of Mercy’s Booterstown, Dominican College Sion Hill, CBC Monkstown, Loreto College Foxrock, Teresians, Mount Anville national, junior and secondary schools, Carysfort National School and Hollypark girls & boys national school.  Smurfit’s Business College is within a short walk and UCD Belfield is also within very close striking distance. 16 Clonfadda Wood represents a rare opportunity to acquire a distinguished detached home in one of South County Dublin's most sought-after suburbs, enjoying an enviably convenient setting and superb family accommodation throughout.
